stories.title: Trump promises $5,000 payments to Americans if GOP wins Congress
new_facts: Vance being cast as Trump's heir-apparent, mulling a 2028 presidential run, per convention coverage.
Texas AG Ken Paxton questioned/embarrassed on Fox News over Trump's $5,000 dividend pledge.
Vance told a protester to 'get your ass' to Mexico during his convention speech.
Trump campaign has expanded midterm spending to $57 million across House and Senate races.
Vance says the $5,000 dividend payments would be funded by tariff revenue.
Republicans reportedly blindsided by dividend plan and doubt it will happen, citing inflation concerns.
Trump says he doesn't think the $5,000 dividend payments would require congressional approval.
stories.line: Trump promises $5,000 payments to Americans contingent on GOP winning House and Senate; experts say the plan is unlikely to happen.

stories.title: Study links nighttime light exposure to heart damage in mice
new_facts: New study finds nighttime light exposure during sleep linked to structural and functional heart changes
stories.line: Study links nighttime light exposure during sleep to cardiac damage in mice; unclear if findings apply to humans.

stories.title: Anthropic blocks AI bioweapon access as ex-researcher warns of existential risk
new_facts: Anthropic's threat intelligence report reveals it disrupted several 2025 attempts to use its models for bioweapons development
Two additional researchers, one from Anthropic and one from Google, publicly warn AI could become 'uncontrollable'
stories.line: Anthropic blocks AI access for biological weapons research; former researcher warns AI poses existential risk to humanity.

stories.title: Detroit funds after-school expansion; Chicago board considers preschool despite leadership resistance
new_facts: New story: Vogue covers Public School's Spring 2027 Menswear collection.
Chicago school board weighs resolution to explore full-day preschool for all 3-year-olds.
Detroit mayor Mary Sheffield announces $2.2 million for 7 new after-school sites.
stories.line: Detroit funds seven new after-school programs; Chicago school board weighs preschool expansion against district leadership objections.

stories.title: Hong Kong jails Tiananmen vigil organizers under national security law
new_facts: Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan sentenced to seven years in prison
Names third organiser Albert Ho as co-defendant alongside Lee and Chow
Chinese AI startup Moonshot reportedly considering dual Hong Kong-Shanghai listing
stories.line: Hong Kong courts sentenced three Tiananmen vigil organizers to seven years in prison under national security law.

stories.title: Spain's Parliament backs citizenship for Western Saharans born before 1977
new_facts: Spain's Congress approved a bill granting citizenship to tens of thousands of Sahrawis; heads to Senate.
Specifies citizenship applies to Western Saharans born before 1977, after lower house approval.
stories.line: Spain's parliament votes to grant citizenship to Western Saharans born before 1977, a move that recognizes a disputed territory's former Spanish colonial subjects.

stories.title: Trump-appointed prosecutor investigating Trump's foes resigns without charges
new_facts: Joe diGenova, tapped by AG Todd Blanche to oversee 'grand conspiracy' probe, resigns from DOJ.
Resigned after less than five months at DOJ; probe based in Florida; frustration from Trump and senior DOJ officials cited.
DiGenova, 81, was part of group that tried to overturn 2020 election; resigned without charging anyone.
stories.line: Trump-appointed prosecutor investigating Trump's political opponents resigns without filing charges after months of work.

stories.title: Kimmel pulls interview from TV after FCC pressure
new_facts: Rep. Ted Lieu publicly criticized ABC and CBS for capitulating to FCC pressure over Kimmel's Talarico interview.
stories.line: Late-night host Jimmy Kimmel cancels planned TV broadcast of interview with Democratic state rep after FCC pressure, drawing criticism from other Democrats.
